extDescription.message: Mute background tabs automatically and find the noisy one. Runs 100% in your browser: no accounts, no tracking.

cmdSolo.message: Mute all other tabs (keep this one playing)

state_follow.message: Hush: sound follows the tab you're on

autoFollowSub.message: Sound follows the tab you're on

followNote.message: Auto-follow takes over again when you turn off the mode above.

pauseSub.message: Unmute what Hush muted and stand by

permBody.message: Let Hush read tab titles so the list says what is playing. Titles stay on your device.

privacyLine.message: Nothing leaves your browser. No accounts, no tracking.

tipText.message: Press $KEY$ to mute everything except the tab you're on.

tipNoKey.message: Set a shortcut in Settings to mute everything except this tab in one keystroke.

optGraceHelp.message: How long the tab you just left keeps playing before it is muted.

optScope.message: Which tab counts as the one you're on

optScopePerWindow.message: The active tab in every window

optScopePerWindowHelp.message: Each window keeps its own current tab audible.

optScopeFocusedHelp.message: Tabs in your other windows stay muted.

optPinnedHelp.message: Auto-follow never mutes a pinned tab, so a pinned music or call tab stays on.

optMuteSilentHelp.message: On: every background tab is muted ahead of time, so nothing can burst in. Off: Hush only mutes tabs that are making sound, which leaves fewer mute icons in your tab bar.

optBadge.message: Show how many tabs are playing on the icon

optPrivacyBody.message: Hush runs entirely in your browser. It has no accounts, no sync and no analytics, and its code makes no network requests.

permStatusOn.message: Tab names are on. The list shows page titles.

permStatusOff.message: Tab names are off. The list shows generic labels, and Hush reads no titles or addresses.

faultBody.message: Some buttons won't work yet. Open chrome://extensions, press Hush's reload icon, and check its Errors button if this stays.
